originalGenerationRecord.exactPromptContent:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one full-body game enemy source drawing for a later native-shape adapter, not runtime delivery.
Create Genshin Impact's HYDRO ABYSS MAGE, faithfully recognizable from identity references 1 and 2. Image 1 (HoYoLAB in-game full body) and image 2 (clear game-render cutout) supply identity ONLY: small floating nonhuman body, long dark navy rabbit-ear hood projections, distinctive WHITE ivory bird-skull mask with TWO DARK oval eye sockets and tapered beak point, thick layered dark cobalt/navy fluffy collar, navy robe with broad pale blue/ivory scrollwork panels and geometric trims, small dark gloves/legs/boots, and slim twisted blue staff with characteristic open curled cage/water-droplet head. The Hydro face is NOT a black face with glowing eyes. Image 3 (our red Pyro Mage drawing) supplies painterly finish and broad material-plane style ONLY, NOT face, colors, staff, costume or pose.
Make a NEW compact left-facing three-quarter hovering battle pose: staff clearly held on left, free gloved hand opens toward left, two short dangling legs readable, not copying reference pose. Keep Hydro's real hood/mask/collar/robe/staff identity, not a Pyro recolor or generic wizard. Mature hand-painted game illustration, broad smooth readable 3-4 value masses per material, modest collar facets and large robe patterns, not tiny ornamental filigree, not low-poly triangulation. Designed to read at 106px and 127px full contain and later approximately600 native shapes. Identity above invention. Full figure AND entire staff inside a square canvas with 7-8 percent clear transparent padding on EVERY side. Center balanced silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha background. No shield bubble, magic effects, particles, splash, aura, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, UI, watermark, frame, extra characters or props. Do not retain any reference background. Source art only; no runtime or approval claim.
originalGenerationRecord.exactRepairPromptContent: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is our game enemy drawing. Make ONLY a framing/padding correction: keep the exact same character identity, costume, mask/eyes, elemental staff design, palette, painterly material planes and overall pose. Uniformly reduce the COMPLETE character plus COMPLETE staff so the whole subject occupies at most 82% of canvas width and at most 82% of canvas height, centered within the same square output. Keep at least 8% completely empty alpha=0 padding at all four edges. Nothing may touch or cross this padding, including antialiasing, glow, loose specks, dust, or stray pixels. Remove all isolated blue/cyan floating specks around silhouette; keep clean antialiased character edges. Preserve genuine transparent background and all connected body parts; no new elements, no floor, no shield, no FX, no text. Do not redesign or add detail. Return only the complete centered transparent character cutout with clear safe padding.
